propositions: Session-scoped provenance fixture incurs >30s setup time in Ubuntu CI because _enclosing and _verdict repeatedly rebuild parent maps and rescan cached AST trees instead of querying once-built indices.

Parsed source trees are cached but parent/enclosing-function and caller relationships are recomputed millions of times per test, yielding 9.5M+ AST walk iterations and 130M+ calls for invariant results.

Immutable per-process parent and caller indices must be built once from already-cached parsed trees and queried by _verdict to preserve all 24 exact ordered provenance tuples while eliminating redundant whole-tree traversal.
A deterministic oracle must enforce that each module contributes to indexing only once and fail when whole-tree caller/parent rediscovery is reintroduced.
